method: Three fresh native production launches and ten warm observations per main scenario in each implementation. Failed/interrupted/profile/injected runs are separate and preserved. No outlier removal. Renderer probes capture trusted dispatch, the first exact visible DOM predicate and the next frame checkpoint; driver preparation is separate. Frame checkpoints alone do not prove pixels painted. Effort requires the expected label after persisted GET in both 3c series. First visibility precedes the historical two frames; legacy menu input also includes closure. Persisted-read verification follows the existing 350 ms observation tail and is not minimum commit latency. Upstream windows may include concurrent background operations and are not request-correlated SQL profiles.

supplemental.body:
## Why

Refs MIN-614. Global encryption exposed additional loading costs in the desktop app. This first measured delivery reduces repeated encrypted PR reads and fixes native renderer style invalidation. MIN-614 remains open for the outstanding acceptance work recorded in its plan.

## Changes

- Coalesce repository identity decoding within each authorized operation, verify immutable index tokens without a writer-key lookup, and parallelize independent PR/count/sync/agent-decoration reads. Preserve source ordering, permission filters, GCM binding, key rotation and provider separation. No plaintext cache persists across requests.
- Replace two root `:has(.app-top-bar)` CSS selectors with a marker owned by the mounted application bar. Preserve native drag/no-drag regions and responsive behavior.
- Move activity-text overflow measurement after layout while preserving its DOM/focus; skip unnecessary board geometry reads when its scroll offset is already restored.
- Add reproducible native/repository benchmarks, aggregate-only before/after evidence, a PostHog error investigation and synthetic light-mode screenshots. No migrations, new dependencies, API contract changes or breaking changes.

## Verification

- 44 focused tests across ten files; supplementary provider/upsert regression coverage.
- Production build, `npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint`, `npm run check:owned-english`, `npm run check:encrypted-access`, `npm run check:encryption-schema`, and `git diff --check` pass. Every commit has a matching DCO sign-off.
- Actual unpackaged Electron 43.7.5, fresh temporary profiles, the existing encrypted 600-issue fixture, and local production servers. No plaintext seeding, profile copying or fabricated forge responses.

| Measurement | Baseline | Candidate | Candidate repeat |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Native issue dialog median | 1,210 ms | 316 ms | 328 ms |
| Native board return median | 1,430 ms | 1,151 ms | 1,108 ms |
| Native PR list route median | 1,400 ms | 739 ms | 3,709 ms |
| Native PR list navigation, one observation | 2,722 ms | 1,821 ms | 2,280 ms |

The native issue style-time median drops from 785 to 138 ms, reproduced at 133 ms. A 51-PR authorized repository read drops from 111 to 11 upstream calls and from 749 to 455 ms in the three warm samples. Native readiness samples are small and are not field INP or p95 estimates. The slower PR repeat and a 48-second successful writer-key-read outlier are retained; no universal end-to-end PR latency improvement is claimed.

Full methodology, observations, PostHog links and follow-ups: [MIN-614 audit](https://github.com/mangue-dev/minddy/blob/66886c54c1b37521f64f98ddc52643fa752fbacf/docs/audits/desktop-perf-min-614.md).

## Risks and dependencies

The board still stalls on activation with 600 rich cards. Loaded feedback, active agent streams, packaged-app behavior and connected-forge detail/diff navigation need further measurements. The fixture has no forge credentials; PR screenshots show stored list readiness and a pending/unavailable detail, not successful forge content. PostHog identity/key/schema errors and Supabase transport latency remain unresolved. This PR must not close MIN-614 or trigger a deployment.

Encryption, RLS, current-writer-key checks and root-key/cache policy remain unchanged. The native titlebar marker changes styling only while the application bar exists; StrictMode cleanup and drag-band policy are covered. Added screenshots contain the repository's synthetic performance fixture only, with no customer content or secrets. No external asset/dependency licensing changes.

## Screenshots

Native issue opening, light-mode synthetic fixture:

![Native issue dialog](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mangue-dev/minddy/66886c54c1b37521f64f98ddc52643fa752fbacf/docs/audits/assets/min-614-issue-light.png)

Stored PR list; the fixture has no connected forge credentials:

![Stored PR list](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mangue-dev/minddy/66886c54c1b37521f64f98ddc52643fa752fbacf/docs/audits/assets/min-614-pr-light.png)

## Checklist

- [x] Scope and measured outcome are associated with MIN-614; unfinished acceptance criteria remain explicit.
- [x] Every commit carries its author's DCO sign-off.
- [x] Regression coverage preserves the changed behavior and encryption guarantees.
- [x] Documentation is updated; locale catalogs require no changes.
- [x] No keys, customer data, private configuration or vulnerability details are included.
- [x] Added resources have documented synthetic origin; no new dependencies.

## Cumulative delivery: pass 2 and subsequent passes

At the user's request, this PR now contains both completed MIN-614 passes and will receive subsequent passes on the same branch, `codex/min-614-encryption-performance`. The original first-pass and pass-2 commits were preserved by fast-forward. PR #343 is superseded; there is no separate dependency to merge. The first-pass results above remain historical evidence; the following measurements use their own baseline and active-view readiness checks.

### Pass 2: retained boards and tab activation

Move public Next router subscriptions from each card to its column and pass the same navigation callback into card content and menu actions. This avoids 1,800 card router subscriptions replaying on the 600-card global board. Preserve React Activity, retained-view limits, live subscriptions, scroll/focus/filters/selection, optimistic drag-and-drop and authorized encrypted reads.

Three fresh native production Electron launches per implementation, with ten warm returns per variant per launch (30 samples per row):

| Scenario | Median readiness before → after | Reduction |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| Close issue → global board | 201 → 198 ms | Essentially unchanged |
| Page → global board | 1,217 → 682 ms | 44% |
| Global → project board | 529 → 399 ms | 25% |
| Project → global board | 972 → 701 ms | 28% |
| Scrolled return | 1,371 → 786 ms | 43% |
| Filtered return | 1,066 → 544 ms | 49% |
| Hidden update → fresh board | 897 → 650 ms | 28% |

The runner requires the selected target tab, a visible non-inert active board, the expected card count and current title after hidden updates, no blocking dialog and two frames. A real Filters-menu click separately measures interaction response. Page-return input falls 217 → 152 ms; hidden-update input rises 224 → 238 ms. Several-hundred-millisecond stalls and cold-start variability remain. Heavy profiles are separate from ordinary samples. Rejected containment, permanently active Activity and catalog experiments are not shipped.

Measured source: baseline `66886c54c1b37521f64f98ddc52643fa752fbacf`; candidate `e08051839177e66b69b251c2cc871884367b091c`. [Pass-2 audit](https://github.com/mangue-dev/minddy/blob/7099e970d4c009b8591cfd7d10112a28f882068d/docs/audits/desktop-perf-min-614-pass-2.md) and [all samples, requests and errors](https://github.com/mangue-dev/minddy/blob/7099e970d4c009b8591cfd7d10112a28f882068d/docs/audits/desktop-perf-min-614-pass-2-results.json) retain runtime, build, dataset, reproduction commands, attribution and limitations.

Pass-2 validation: 136 focused tests in 19 files; production build, types, lint, owned-English, encrypted-access/schema checks and diff checks passed. Supplemental browser checks cover retained state, focus, shortcuts, drag persistence/reversal, eviction and tab closure. First-pass style and repository call-count gains were reverified. This consolidation only changes documentation; owned-English and diff checks pass again, and all four commits have matching DCO sign-offs.

PostHog key/identity/schema errors were inspected; sampled events lack route/release/session dimensions needed to establish a board-version cause. Connected forge, populated feedback/agent sessions, broader issue/Page workflows and packaged-release coverage remain open. The cumulative coverage matrix and next issue-details/activity/comments/relations/mutations pass are recorded in MIN-614. Keep MIN-614 in progress; this PR does not authorize merging or production deployment.

Restored filtered board in light mode (supplemental browser correctness capture, not a native timing sample):

![Pass-2 restored filtered board](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mangue-dev/minddy/1d3fb577cd5e5d338a3a619e0d75f8e8590647b1/docs/audits/assets/min-614-pass-2-restored-board-light.png)


## Pass 3: loaded issue details and mutations

Opening a loaded issue fetched the full automation simulation even though its status bar consumes only the current chain. The bar now uses an authorized `view=chain` read; the default route retains simulation and estimation for its consumers. Caller RLS, live-session authorization, current chain reads and parent-prefix realtime/start/resume/stop invalidation are preserved. There is no persistent plaintext cache or encryption/key-policy change.

Three fresh native Electron launches before and after, with ten warm repetitions per main scenario, retain 792 ordinary observations and 120 persisted mutation confirmations. Complete active-view readiness checks the entire description, original comments, current title and successful detail API state.

| Issue journey | Before median | After median |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| Warm complete opening | 387 ms | 318 ms |
| Scrolled-board opening | 384 ms | 296 ms |
| Filtered-board opening | 390 ms | 277 ms |
| Reopen after retained return | 394 ms | 351 ms |

The four opening variants improve in every candidate launch. A separate alternating server control completes 30 reads of each variant: full/status medians 262/197 ms, with five/three monitored REST operations. The fixture has no active chain, so active automation/estimate interactions remain unmeasured.

Cold complete opening is 656/673 ms, comment edit 750/793 ms, effort confirmation 476/482 ms and comment confirmation 524/530 ms; no gain is claimed for those paths. Warm opening still has a roughly 176 ms long task and 144 ms style work. The filtered menu probe increases from 101 to 134 ms, and retained reopen p95 worsens. Failed/partial runs, canceled reads, remote authorization RPC deadlines and scoped restoration evidence remain explicit. A local server restart uses the same compiled candidate; no guard is bypassed to make measurements succeed.

Baseline: `7099e970d4c009b8591cfd7d10112a28f882068d`; product candidate: `71428008c11375ef0559c34c3019761ad17663f7`; final benchmark capture: `b49100b92`; delivery: `b0f7f46e58e2cda575d207e558237fc041683e3b`. Actual unpackaged Electron 43.7.5, Chromium 150.0.7871.250, production Next build, migrated marked MIN-540 encrypted fixture (600 issues). Build IDs, source hashes, dataset/history drift, network conditions and commands are retained in the [pass-3 audit](https://github.com/mangue-dev/minddy/blob/b0f7f46e58e2cda575d207e558237fc041683e3b/docs/audits/desktop-perf-min-614-pass-3.md), [complete results](https://github.com/mangue-dev/minddy/blob/b0f7f46e58e2cda575d207e558237fc041683e3b/docs/audits/desktop-perf-min-614-pass-3-results.json), and lossless upstream [before](https://github.com/mangue-dev/minddy/blob/b0f7f46e58e2cda575d207e558237fc041683e3b/docs/audits/assets/min-614-pass-3-upstream-before.jsonl.gz)/[after](https://github.com/mangue-dev/minddy/blob/b0f7f46e58e2cda575d207e558237fc041683e3b/docs/audits/assets/min-614-pass-3-upstream-after.jsonl.gz) archives. Prior pass-1/pass-2 audits, results and screenshots are unchanged.

Validation: 214 targeted tests in 29 files; reference/candidate production builds, types, lint, owned-English, encrypted-access/schema checks and diff checks passed. Native rollback/retry/canonical-relation/resource/child checks revalidate MIN-630 without duplicating its implementation. Browser correctness checks cover focus, filter/selection/scroll, drag persistence and reversal, retention limits and eviction. Previous style and encrypted PR read gains hold (PR list remains 11 monitored calls); supplemental native retained Page return is 669 ms, scrolled return 661 ms and filtered return 486 ms. Heavy CPU/trace captures remain outside ordinary medians.

PostHog key/identity/schema errors were inspected through MCP; sampled server events lack route/release/session dimensions needed to correlate them with this candidate. None is claimed fixed.

Next: pass 3b should address persisted comment/edit and hidden-update costs, loaded description/plan autosave, larger threads, objectives/resources and interrupted/concurrent writes. Connected forge, active chains/agents, prolonged native backgrounding and signed-package coverage remain open. MIN-614 remains **in progress**. No GitHub closing references or auto-merge request are present. Minddy separately maps a linked **merged** PR to done, so a later authorized merge must explicitly keep/reopen the program until acceptance is complete. This update does not merge, run work:done or deploy.

Synthetic fixture in native Electron, light mode, captured outside timed observations:

![Pass-3 loaded issue description](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mangue-dev/minddy/b0f7f46e58e2cda575d207e558237fc041683e3b/docs/audits/assets/min-614-pass-3-issue-light.png)

![Pass-3 original comments and relation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mangue-dev/minddy/b0f7f46e58e2cda575d207e558237fc041683e3b/docs/audits/assets/min-614-pass-3-activity-light.png)


## MIN-614 phase 3b: comment persistence, reactivation and mutation evidence

Continue the same cumulative branch and PR. Baseline `b0f7f46e58e2cda575d207e558237fc041683e3b`; measured product `b135cc3f22d1263bde321a7c373a60641139143c`; evidence/recovery delivery `6582b8dacf7c361ba5971729eb5b7806da5a2331`. All earlier audits, samples and screenshots remain.

Comment reads previously serialized independent authorized operations, and self-only comment notifications performed two unnecessary membership reads. Run independent caller-RLS thread/scope and actor/forge-sidecar reads concurrently; skip membership reads only when no other recipient exists. Current access, recipient membership, encryption, key rotation/revocation and error handling remain. DELETE routing now uses OLD parent metadata when NEW is a non-null all-null projection. Timeline activation performs an authoritative comments/events read despite a recent cache while preserving pending UUID overlays and streaming polling.

Three fresh native Electron production launches and ten warm attempts per main scenario on 26 comments/six replies: 348 observations and 120 mutation-stage records per implementation. Every write identity is journaled before acknowledgement when client-generated; server-generated relation/resource identities are resolved from the journaled request scope before cleanup. Timed writes are never replayed automatically. All original fields/comment IDs/bodies/relations/resources/child parents and temporary tabs are verified restored; audit history is retained.

| Creation clock, median milliseconds | Before | After |
|---|---:|---:|
| Observed optimistic row | 61.2 | 61.6 |
| Server acknowledgement | 462.2 | 412.2 |
| Authenticated persisted verification from interaction | 780.5 | 669.4 |
| Exact visible thread reconciliation | 1,100.1 | 885.2 |

Acknowledgement improves 10.8% and visible reconciliation 19.5%, consistently across launches. The verification/reconciliation clocks include the historical 350 ms observation tail; actual verification GET falls 286→227 ms. This is not a minimum commit-latency or field-INP claim.

Editing, deletion and effort first response/acknowledgement do not improve; delete/effort p95 regressions remain. Loaded warm opening is 307.2→313.8 ms and hidden reopen 723.3→848.0 ms. Candidate primary retains **one failed hidden availability attempt out of 30**, with a 5.28 s failed clock and successful untimed recovery; the browser GET lacks a completion record at the bound. An incomplete candidate run also retains slow successful >5 s detail reads. Prior 500/503 and eight-second `auth_authorization_state` failures are **not resolved** or bypassed, and network/transport/SQL causation is not established.

The paired isolated mounted remote-delete diagnostic previously left the deleted UUID visible and now reconciles correctly. Independent activation tests verify recent-cache refresh, failed draft retention and echo deduplication. Fresh native correctness checks cover pre-write failure/retry/newer draft, failed edit/delete preservation, lost acknowledgement after a successful commit without replay, reverse-order concurrent writes, property rollback and ten post-persistence visible-effort cycles, MIN-630 held/canonical relation and rollback, a populated encrypted Page resource/child navigation, focus, renderer suspension and actual offline/online remote edit/deletion. A probe initially matched relation endpoints in noncanonical order and failed cleanup; launches stopped, scoped authorized recovery verified the original state, both failures were retained, and the corrected fresh probe passed. MIN-630 implementation is unchanged.

Earlier probes revalidated standard/scrolled/filtered openings at 324.2/299.1/276.0 ms, ~144 ms issue style versus historical pre-pass-1 785 ms, retained returns, selection/filter/scroll/hotkeys/drag/reversal/eviction, encrypted PR REST counts 7/11/7/13, and chain status 202.5 ms/three operations versus full simulation 274.4 ms/five. Empty chains do not cover active execution. Residual hidden-return frame stalls remain ~417 ms. Filtered/scrolled first-input isolation, conflicting multi-client edits, objective/binary resources, populated feedback/agents/connected forge and production error correlation remain explicit gaps.

Validation: 232 targeted tests in 33 files; production builds, types, lint, owned-English, encrypted-access/schema and diff checks pass. All 12 cumulative non-merge commits have exact author-matching DCO trailers. Earlier audits/results, migrations, translations, dependencies/lockfiles, vendor patches and Mangue-ui remain unchanged. PostHog MCP investigation has no usable sampled route/release/session dimensions, so no candidate correlation or error-resolution claim.

[Phase 3b audit and coverage matrix](https://github.com/mangue-dev/minddy/blob/codex/min-614-encryption-performance/docs/audits/desktop-perf-min-614-pass-3b.md) · [Complete separate samples, commands, hashes and recovery evidence](https://github.com/mangue-dev/minddy/blob/codex/min-614-encryption-performance/docs/audits/desktop-perf-min-614-pass-3b-results.json)

Refs MIN-614. Global encryption exposed additional loading costs in the desktop app. This first measured delivery reduces repeated encrypted PR reads and fixes native renderer style invalidation. MIN-614 remains open for the outstanding acceptance work recorded in its plan.

## Changes

- Coalesce repository identity decoding within each authorized operation, verify immutable index tokens without a writer-key lookup, and parallelize independent PR/count/sync/agent-decoration reads. Preserve source ordering, permission filters, GCM binding, key rotation and provider separation. No plaintext cache persists across requests.
- Replace two root `:has(.app-top-bar)` CSS selectors with a marker owned by the mounted application bar. Preserve native drag/no-drag regions and responsive behavior.
- Move activity-text overflow measurement after layout while preserving its DOM/focus; skip unnecessary board geometry reads when its scroll offset is already restored.
- Add reproducible native/repository benchmarks, aggregate-only before/after evidence, a PostHog error investigation and synthetic light-mode screenshots. No migrations, new dependencies, API contract changes or breaking changes.

## Verification

- 44 focused tests across ten files; supplementary provider/upsert regression coverage.

| Native board return median | 1,430 ms | 1,151 ms | 1,108 ms |
| Native PR list route median | 1,400 ms | 739 ms | 3,709 ms |
| Native PR list navigation, one observation | 2,722 ms | 1,821 ms | 2,280 ms |

PostHog identity/key/schema errors and Supabase transport latency remain unresolved. This PR must not close MIN-614 or trigger a deployment.

Encryption, RLS, current-writer-key checks and root-key/cache policy remain unchanged.
